Paper reports decay-rate/annihilation limits only (lambda [s^-1], <sigma v>); the GT g_agamma value is the repo maintainer's derived physics conversion and never appears in the paper, so it is not extractable.

Published-version-only content: the d_e ultralight-DM limit (repo BACON.txt) exists only in the published Nature 591, 564 (2021) figure; no arXiv version of the paper contains it, so it is unreachable from the benchmark's input PDF.
GT digitizes private-communication data: BlackHoleSpins_Mehta.txt's own header says the 178-point BHSR compilation came via 'private communication'; it is not published in the paper PDF.

Wrong GT mapping: LSW_UWA.txt is arXiv:1410.5244's limit (per the file header). This paper's own limit (chi = 2.9e-5 at 37.9 ueV, stated to lie 'within already established limits') has no repo data file, so there is nothing valid to grade against.

GammaRayDecayCompilation.txt is a compilation of PRE-EXISTING gamma-ray decay limits (HEAO-1/COMPTEL/EGRET/Fermi) shown as background in this paper's figure — not the paper's own result. The paper's headline (HERA 21-cm projection) is keyed separately.
